title: Overload Options
text: Select CPU overload options, 1 input, 1 output; {Startup Duration} selects startup steps for ignoring CPU, {Source} sets the selects CPU overload input during startup Tunable, {Max Overloads} selects maximum CPU overloads and {Enable TET Output} enables output TET data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Startup Duration
params.values: Select startup steps for ignoring CPU overloads 1 (default) | int

params.name: Source
params.values: Selects CPU overload input during startup Tunable Parameter (default) | Input Port

params.name: Enable TET Output
params.values: Enable output TET data off (default) | on
